text:
alex: Kicking off phased geo rollout for model v2.3. Sequence: US -> EU -> APAC. Change window 02:00-06:00 UTC. Canary 3% in US, then 25% -> 100% if stable. Pin route to v2.3 during the rollout.

deploybot: Scheduled deploy dpl-1713204321 queued. Canary slice=3% (us-east1), rollout policy=phased, warmup=enabled. ETA to canary start ~5m.

maya: quick Q — do we have warm-pool numbers per region? want to ensure no OOM when we go 25%.

liam: us: warm pool 12 gpus (2x baseline), eu: 8 gpus, apac: 4 gpus reserved. pre-warm script ran at 01:40 UTC.

nina: APAC quota still low on customer acct but infra reserved should be fine for canary. flagging that APAC auto-scaler may be slow (<90s) if we need to burst. Recommend keep APAC at 0% until US/EU stable. :red_circle:

alex: agreed. plan: US canary -> wait 10m smoke -> EU canary (3%) -> wait 10m smoke -> decision point for APAC. We'll keep APAC pinned at v2.2 until green.

deploybot: Canary started in us-east1 (slice 3%). dpl-1713204321: canary_instance_count=3, model=v2.3, traffic=3%. Logs streaming to /deploys/dpl-1713204321/logs

opsbot: smoke tests started — hitting /health, /generate, /embeddings. Returning basic checks.

opsbot: smoke results (summary):
```
/health -> 200 OK (p95=45ms)
/generate -> sanity tokens ok, p95=210ms, error_rate=0.1%
/embeddings -> p95=120ms
```

maya: looks good for US. can we watch 95th latency and error rate for 10m before EU? also ensure KV cache warm ratio >80%.

liam: KV cache warm ratio in US is 84% after 6m. p95 trending stable.

sre-jen: Rollback triggers (explicit):
- request error_rate > 2% for 5m OR
- p95 latency > 600ms sustained for 5m OR
- increased 4xx/5xx client errors affecting >1% traffic for 5m.
If any trigger hit: immediate pause rollout, rollback canary -> v2.2 for affected region, notify on-call, start postmortem.

sre-jen: rollback command (immediate): `deploybot rollback --deploy-id dpl-1713204321 --regions us-east1 --to-version v2.2 --force`

alex: EU canary start in ~12m if US remains green. Nina will still keep APAC hold.

nina: ack, I'll monitor APAC quotas and pre-reserve additional capacity if needed. ping me if we want to enable APAC canary earlier.

deploybot: EU canary scheduled: dpl-1713204321-eu starting in 12m, slice=3%, model=v2.3.

opsbot: EU smoke started when canary up — initial checks showing p95 generate=260ms, error_rate=0.2%. KV cache warm ratio 78% (warming).

maya: EU KV ratio under 80% but p95 still fine. recommend wait another 6m and re-evaluate.

liam: bumping EU pre-warm by +2 gpus (temp) to speed KV warm. Command: `infra scale --region eu-west1 --add 2 --reason "v2.3 warmup"`

opsbot: scale request accepted, new warm nodes joining.

opsbot: EU smoke update 10m: p95 generate=240ms, error_rate=0.15%, KV warm ratio=86%.

alex: EU green. moving to 25% in US + EU as staged roll. APAC still on hold.

deploybot: Increasing traffic: US 25% (slice ratchet), EU 25%. dpl-1713204321 updated. Monitoring for 15m.

opsbot: runbook note: when increasing slices, watch token cost spike and burst latencies. Set alert: `alert if p95 increases >30% from baseline for 5m`

sre-jen: If we see sustained CPU/GPU thermal events in any region, follow thermal fallback: reduce per-GPU batch-size, lower concurrency by 20%, and if persists >10m, revert region to v2.2.

maya: small anomaly in US: a single host returning repeated 500s (6 instances). rate ~0.3% overall. watching.

liam: isolating host in us-east1-3. draining connections.

opsbot: host drain complete. retry routing off that host. aggregate error rate back to 0.12%.

nina: re APAC — I've requested a soft quota bump; vendor replied ETA 4h. won't be in-window. keep APAC on hold.

alex: decision: continue full rollout in US/EU to 100%. APAC deferred to maintenance window tomorrow. Everyone OK?

maya: ok from me. :thumbsup:

liam: ok.

sre-jen: final checks: schedule post-deploy validation run in 30m to confirm SLOs, run synthetic prompt sets, check model quality regressions in eval dashboard. If regression detected, manual rollback process applies (notify product + ML).

deploybot: Rollout COMPLETE in US+EU. dpl-1713204321: us=100%, eu=100%, apac=0% (pinned to v2.2). Release notes URL: https://releases.redwood.ai/dpl-1713204321/notes

alex: thanks all. I'll open a short retrospective tomorrow AM and schedule APAC window.

nina: filing APAC follow-up ticket now.

opsbot: tagging monitoring playbook: #incidents/ops/rollouts for any follow-ups.

sre-jen: closing thread but will keep watch on overnight alerts. if anything above thresholds, escalate to on-call and trigger rollback.

alex: great run. :tada:
